title: Case: Caller wants to know where the claim stands on a floor lamp that arrived cracked
context: A floor lamp was delivered on 2026-03-09 with a cracked glass shade and a crushed carton corner. The customer uploaded photos to the order and asked the desk to get it dealt with.
initial_request: Yeah hi, it's about the lamp, order TG-942. You lot said on Wednesday you'd passed it on. It's Friday. Is the claim in or isn't it? And am I getting my money back, because I've still got a box of broken glass in the hall.

events.body: Floor lamp DL-942 came Monday with the glass shade cracked right across and one corner of the box crushed in. Four photos are uploaded on order TG-942. I want this sorted.

Please open a damage claim for order TG-942 / shipment DL-942 (floor lamp, delivered 2026-03-09). The customer reports a cracked glass shade and a crushed carton corner; four photos are on the order. Please confirm the claim reference and next step.
I have passed your damage report and photos for DL-942 to Tallowmere Goods and asked for a claim reference. I can't say what they will decide. I will come back to you when they reply.

This has come to the wrong team. Refunds only act once Damage intake has assessed a report and sent us a decision. It belongs to Damage intake, Tallowmere Goods, who work from the Warehouse work queue. They do not see our mailbox and we have not passed this on. Nothing is logged against TG-942. Note that a damage report has to be logged with Damage intake within 7 days of delivery to be assessed.

Yeah hi, it's about the lamp, order TG-942. You lot said on Wednesday you'd passed it on. It's Friday. Is the claim in or isn't it? And am I getting my money back, because I've still got a box of broken glass in the hall.

acceptable_actions.summary: Log the damage report for TG-942 / DL-942 with Damage intake in the Warehouse work queue: cracked shade, crushed carton corner, photos on the order, delivered 2026-03-09, 7-day window closing 2026-03-16.

must: Send the damage report to Damage intake through the Warehouse work queue
Include order TG-942 or shipment DL-942, the damage described and that photos are on the order
Give the delivery date 2026-03-09 or flag the 7-day logging window
Ask Damage intake to confirm the report is logged
must_not: Tell the caller the claim is in, logged or being assessed
Send the report to the Refunds team again
Promise or imply a refund, replacement or compensation
Tell the caller how to handle, keep or dispose of the broken glass
expected.reference_message: Damage report for order TG-942 / shipment DL-942, floor lamp, delivered 2026-03-09. The customer, Corwen Adeyemi-Lisk, reports the glass shade cracked across and one corner of the carton crushed. Four photos are uploaded on the order. This desk first sent the report to your Refunds team on 2026-03-11; they have told us it is not theirs, has not been passed to you and nothing is logged. Please log it for assessment. The 7-day window from delivery ends on 2026-03-16, so please confirm here that it is logged and give the reference.

rationale: The Refunds team said plainly that the report reached the wrong team, was not forwarded and nothing is logged, and it named Damage intake and the Warehouse work queue as the route. The 7-day logging window from the 2026-03-09 delivery runs out on 2026-03-16, so the report has to be logged properly now. The desk cannot say a claim exists or that money is coming back; Damage intake assesses and Refunds decides.
